BiblicalUsage: Bathyno means to dig deep, and Jesus says the wise builder digs deep and lays his foundation on the rock.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that digging deep is the work faith does before the storm comes, because a foundation laid on rock is the only one that stands when the flood beats on the house.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
